description_en: Update the ticket quantity on the specified ticket used for the exemption embedded report
description_zh: 对用于免登嵌入报表的指定的ticket进行更新票据数量操作
name: UpdateTicketNum

parameters.help_en: The value of the third-party embedded ticket, that is, the accessTicket value in the URL
parameters.help_zh: 三方嵌入的票据值，即URL中的accessTicket值
parameters.name: ticket

parameters.help_en:
The number of bills.

Valid values: 1 to 99998. Recommended value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
票据数。
取值范围：1~99998，建议值为1
parameters.name: ticket_num

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the update is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Result.description_zh:
是否更新成功。取值范围：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
